controls.description: size-only confound control: AUC from chain length n_CA alone under the same label permutation. A label permutation does NOT protect against a size classifier, so this is the control that matters.
controls.detail: topology AUC 1.000 vs size AUC 0.464 (|AUC-0.5|: 0.500 vs 0.036)

controls.description: 10000 label permutations give the null distribution of |AUC - 0.5|

findings.claim: Pre-registered test: h1_small_bar_density separates all-alpha (n=14) from all-beta (n=4) C-alpha clouds with AUC 1.000, permutation p 0.0009; the chain-length-only baseline gives AUC 0.464. Verdict: SEPARATES.
findings.caveat: n = 14 + 4 structures; fold class is this pipeline's own HELIX/SHEET count, not CATH or SCOP; a label permutation tests exchangeability only, which is why the size baseline is reported beside it
